_comment: Wine Ferrari motion table — LOCKED GROUND TRUTH (verified by QuickTime frame-stepping + multi-method optical flow). Pixel magnitudes are in OUTPUT pixel coordinates at 1080w. Direction convention: positive_x = camera moves RIGHT, positive_y = camera moves DOWN, zoom_delta > 0 = push-in.

shots.subject: Side profile, full car
shots.purpose: Establishing shot — sets aesthetic, scale, and lighting

shots.subject: Rear-left 3/4, full car

motion.type: yaw right (camera rotates right) + slight pull-back

shots.purpose: Aero hero — reveals wing and widebody stance

shots.subject: Wing badge ECU (Ferrari prancing horse on wing endplate)

motion.type: pan right + slight tilt up (upward arc over wing)

shots.subject: Direct front, full car
shots.purpose: Symmetry mirror of shot 4 — front-rear A/B rhyme

shots.subject: Front hood/bonnet detail (high angle, fender + badge + hood vent + windshield base)
shots.camera_position: Front-right of car, slightly above hood, looking down
shots.purpose: Detail tease — opens the front-of-car chapter

shots.subject: Front-left 3/4, full car (HERO REVEAL)
shots.purpose: HERO — climactic 'look at the whole car' beat

shots.subject: Front-left wheel close-up (low angle, wheel + fender + splitter + side mirror)
shots.camera_position: Low ground-level, front-left, tight on wheel

motion.type: pan left + slight tilt up + push-in

shots.purpose: Outro detail — closes film with reverse-direction release

edit_pattern.cadence: First 4 shots ~2.2s (slow), last 4 shots ~1.05s (punchy) — film accelerates
edit_pattern.directional_arc: 5 shots move camera right (1 push-in counts as 'into'), 1 left (shot 8 release), 4 tilt up — overall rightward + upward 'lift' feeling
edit_pattern.structural_match_cuts: Shot 4 (dead rear) → Shot 5 (dead front) is the editorial anchor
